title: Nutty Indian Soybean Sprouts Naan
description: A pungent and cheesy Indian dish featuring soybean sprouts and served with a naan bread, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together soybean sprouts, shio cure, garam masala, cumin seeds, coriander powder, and salt.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the sprout mixture for 5 minutes.
Place the naan bread on a salt block and top with the sprout mixture and mozzarella cheese.
Bake the naan in the preheated oven for 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy.
Remove the naan from the oven and let it cool for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve the naan hot and enjoy.
Garnish with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
